title: We'll Be Like Him 559 /
firstLine: When the Savior comes for His chosen ones

lines: When the Savior comes for His chosen ones
We'll be like Him, We'll be like Him
When the bright day breaks and the dead awakes;
We'll be like Him when He comes.
Let the message ring over hill and plain,
We'll be like Him, We'll be like Him
Send it far and wide on the gospel tide;
We'll be like Him when He comes.
He's the One we love, He's the One we prove,
We'll be like Him, We'll be like Him
He's the One who cheers thru the weary years;
We'll be like Him when He comes.
Tho' He tarry long, this will be our song,
We'll be like Him, We'll be like Him
Tho' the path be dim we will cling to Him;
We'll be like Him when He comes.
s. We'll be like Him, sing the glad refrain;
We'll be like Him when He come again;
Blessed thought to me that His face I'll see,
And be like Him when He comes.
